Name: Rent a Fish Pond
Author: wulinbiji
Description:
[b]包鱼塘 · Rent a Fish Pond[/b]

Lao Liang wants 5,000g for the pond. Something just broke the surface. Is it a school of gold-quality fish, or the only fish in the water? You pay before the pump starts.

老梁开价 5,000 金，水面刚好扑腾了一下。底下是一群金星鱼，还是整口塘就这一条？得先交租开泵，才能知道。

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55981/55981-1795523377-108654681.gif[/img]

[b]Finding the pond[/b]
Leave your farm by the east exit. At the Bus Stop, look for the wooden fish sign on the north side of the road to town. Walk north through the fence opening to Reedwater Pond (芦湾塘). Talk to Lao Liang on the south bank. F8 also takes you there and back while your farmer is free to move.

[b]Taking a contract[/b]
Choose a pond for 2,500g, 5,000g or 10,000g. Watch the intake swirl and the pump throw water across the bank. When the mud appears, walk up to a bubbling spot and use your action button. There are seven spots across three draining stages. Each scoop shows the quality, quantity and value of the catch, including empty nets. Take your time.

You might drain the pond and find it completely empty. But even the cheapest pond can hide a treasure chest and pearls. The chance is 0.3% per pond, whichever rental you choose. At the prices in effect when you sign, selling the treasure alone can cover the rent and leave you with at least ten times that amount in profit.

Keep your catch or sell the whole batch from the final bill. Lao Liang also buys fish from elsewhere in your backpack at your farmer’s in-game sale price. If your backpack fills up, he holds the overflow for you.

[b]Installation and compatibility[/b]
Tested on PC with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. Single-player only. The mod follows the game language automatically: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Spanish and Turkish. Extract the PondRush folder into Stardew Valley/Mods and launch with SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and lets you change F8.

[b]中文玩法[/b]
从农场东口到公交站，沿通往镇子的小路，找到北侧围栏上挂鲤鱼的木牌。往北穿过缺口就是芦湾塘。南岸的老梁有三档塘可包，塘费分别是 2,500、5,000 和 10,000 金。也可以在角色自由行动时按 F8 往返。

签好合同，等水退到露出泥滩。走到冒泡的水圈旁按交互键下网，三次退水，七处可捞。每一网都能看见鱼的品质、数量和估值。可能一网金星，也可能整塘摸空。七网捞完，鱼可以自己留着，也能在收塘单上一键卖清。平时找老梁点「老梁收鱼」，别处钓来的鱼他也收。

有的塘抽干了，一条鱼也摸不到。可就算是最便宜的塘，塘底也可能藏着财宝箱和珍珠。三档鱼塘的藏宝概率都是千分之三（0.3%）。按签约时的售价卖掉宝物，光这一网就能收回塘租，再净赚至少十倍塘租。

[b]安装[/b]
适用于 PC 单人农场，游戏内随原版自动切换，支持简中、英语、法语、德语、匈牙利语、意大利语、日语、韩语、巴西葡萄牙语、俄语、西班牙语和土耳其语。安装 SMAPI，把压缩包中的 PondRush 文件夹放进游戏的 Mods 目录，再用 SMAPI 启动。通用 Mod 配置菜单可选，用来更改进塘快捷键。

[b]Credits and AI disclosure / 制作说明[/b]
Stardew Valley by ConcernedApe. Mod concept and play direction by wulin. OpenAI Codex was used for the mod code, UI, dialogue, translations and page text. Lao Liang’s portrait and character artwork were created with generative AI. The cover and GIF use footage recorded in-game. 老梁的头像和角色美术使用了生成式 AI，封面和动图取自游戏实录。
